newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares set to climb modestly after Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares set to climb modestly after Dow rise.

text.p: Danish share prices rose in early trade on Wednesday boosted by the overnight rise on Wall Street, the strong dollar and unchanged bonds with dealers seeing only modest rises ahead due to ongoing EMU uncertainty.

"Interest slumped yesterday after Monday's KFX index record closing high. France's call for a delay before agreeing the EMU stability pact has put a damper on the market, so Dow-inspired rises will be limited," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index gained 0.33 point to 170.71 at 0800 GMT, after closing a marginal 0.02 point lower on Tuesday.--Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
